statements.text: FRAM MARINE AS is registered with the organisation number 993973645 and has the legal form AS.
The company operates in the industry of other technical consultancy activities and was founded on March 15, 2009.
The company's website reports that it combines years of experience in project execution and management with technical and operational expertise in the Marine, Energy, and Renewable industry.

Revenue decreased from 40,012,265 NOK in the period from 2023-01-01 to 2023-12-31 down to 31,994,381 NOK in the period from 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31, and further down to 25,943,930 NOK in the period from 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31.
Operating result went down from 5,147,707 NOK in the 2023 period to 2,143,423 NOK in the 2024 period, and then to -870,904 NOK in the 2025 period.
Karen Grøttheim Algaard serves as the chief executive officer while Per Grieg is the board chair.
